items.title: Amazon EC2 M9g instances now available in additional regions
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M9g instances, powered by AWS Graviton5 processors, are available in US West (N. California), Canada (Central), South America (São Paulo), and Asia Pacific (Seoul) regions.

items.title: Elastic Load Balancing for Envoy is now generally available
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of ELB for Envoy, a new load balancer type in Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) that runs open-source Envoy proxies.

items.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports minor versions 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25
items.blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for PostgreSQL now supports the latest minor versions 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25.

sections.heading: AWS IoT and AI speech services

items.title: Amazon Transcribe Turbo: more accurate transcripts and natural turn-taking for voice agents, now in public preview
items.blurb: Amazon Transcribe Turbo, our next-generation speech-to-text model, is now in public preview in US East (Ohio) for batch and streaming.

items.title: AWS IoT Core now uses dedicated IPv6 address ranges for the HTTP rule action
items.blurb: AWS IoT Core can now send traffic to HTTPS endpoints within a dedicated, published IPv6 address range.

items.title: AWS IoT Core quotas and usage are now visible in AWS Service Quotas console
items.blurb: AWS IoT Core now publishes its most used service quotas and your current usage against the quotas in AWS Service Quotas console , improving observability and monitoring of API limits and quotas.

items.title: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes
items.blurb: Netflix developed Quasar, an internal tool that combines semantic code indexing and API comparisons to identify downstream consumers affected by library changes.
